title: Zeros or X-Intercepts
text: The numerator is $$1$$, so the function can never equal $$0$$.

title: Domain
text: The square root is in the denominator, so require $$x-9>0$$. Therefore $$x>9$$.

title: Range
text: The function is always positive. It grows without bound near $$x=9$$ and approaches $$0$$ without reaching it as $$x$$ increases.
